name: Rug Doctor Deep Carpet Cleaner Upright Machine
description: Stop renting and own professional-grade cleaning power! This genuine Rug Doctor Deep Carpet Cleaner (Model DCC-1) delivers industrial-strength extraction right to your home. It features a Dual Cross-Action brush system with two rows of bristles that vibrate and scrub deeply to clean every carpet fiber from all angles in a single pass. Equipped with a Super Boost Spray dial to toggle on extra solution for stubborn pet stains or heavy-foot-traffic zones, and a simple-lift dual tank system that separates clean water from dirty wastewater effortlessly. Also includes a long flexible hose attachment with an upholstery tool perfect for cleaning stairs, couches, or detailing vehicle interiors. Exceptionally powerful, well-maintained, and ready to make your rugs look brand new!
contact_note: Fully tested, holds pressure perfectly with zero leaks, and both intake and spray pumps work flawlessly. Thoroughly rinsed, deep-cleaned, and ready for pickup!
meta_description: Pre-owned Rug Doctor DCC-1 upright deep carpet cleaner in good condition. Dual cross-action brushes, super boost spray dial, upholstery tool hose included.
name_zh: 地毯地垫深层清洗专家 Rug Doctor DCC-1 家用立式抽吸清洗机/洗地机
description_zh: 告别昂贵的地毯租借，一步到位拥有一家专业级的地毯深层洗护神器！这款经典的 Rug Doctor DCC-1 家用立式地毯清洗机，搭载独家的 Dual Cross-Action 双重交叉震动毛刷系统，能在单次推行中从各个角度强力揉搓、洗净每一根地毯纤维。机身配有 Super Boost 强力喷雾拨轮，可针对顽固污渍或高频踩踏区域追加高浓度洗剂；采用双独立透明大水箱，净污分离，倾倒清洗绝不弄脏手。随机额外附送超长软管及沙发布艺手持吸头，不仅能洗楼梯、清理沙发垫，还能为汽车织物内饰做精细清洗。泵压稳定，吸力强劲，全功能完好。
